        lastName:

          title: Address

            precedence over this flat field. On read it is the composed address:
            the normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is present, falling back to
            the normalized flat address when no structured line is given.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Optional.
            When present (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' and is
            normalized to canonical form (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased,
            common street-type abbreviations expanded). An owner is valid when it
            supplies either a non-blank 'addressLine1' or the flat 'address', plus a
            city.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (unit,
            suite, etc.). When present it is normalized like 'addressLine1' and
            appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The normalized value is stored and
            returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is normalized to lower case before it is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'

            for the owner's city per a fixed table keyed by the city's region
            (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne -> VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane ->
            QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Rejected with 400 when out of range for the city's region.

            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the

                stored 'telephone'; the raw E.164 value remains in 'telephone'.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-

                (NSW/VIC/QLD, or UNKNOWN) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the owner's normalized E.164 telephone
                concatenated with the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit

            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-

                where <customerCode> is the owner's customer code and YY is the
                last two digits of the fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted
                registration date (the fiscal year starts on 1 July). Derived from
                the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registration
                date, formatted 'FY<YY>' where the fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is identified by the calendar year in which it ends (so a July-to-
                December date falls in the next calendar year's fiscal year) and YY
                is that year's last two digits. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners who belong to the same
                household (same last name and postcode). Computed deterministically
                as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last
                name and the postcode, so every owner with the same last name and
                postcode maps to the same value regardless of creation order.

              example: '9e107d9d372b'
              readOnly: true

            ownerSegment:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When present it is used to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on create for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it takes
            precedence over this flat field. On read it is the composed address:
            the normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is present, falling back to
            the normalized flat address when no structured line is given.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Optional.
            When present (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' and is
            normalized to canonical form (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased,
            common street-type abbreviations expanded). An owner is valid when it
            supplies either a non-blank 'addressLine1' or the flat 'address', plus a
            city.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (unit,
            suite, etc.). When present it is normalized like 'addressLine1' and
            appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The normalized value is stored and
            returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is normalized to lower case before it is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid
            for the owner's city per a fixed table keyed by the city's region
            (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne -> VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane ->
            QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Rejected with 400 when out of range for the city's region.
            The value is stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. The stored value is returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional.
            When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand', computed as
            the owner's age against the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only flag. When true, the owner may be created even though
            another owner already shares the same household (same last name and
            postcode) - an intentional shared household - and is then created as
            a declared household member. When false or omitted, such a duplicate
            is rejected with 409 Conflict. It only bypasses the duplicate block;
            it does not create the household link (that is derived from the last
            name and postcode). Not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                A link to this owner's own resource, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'
                where <id> is the owner's id. Derived from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the honorific 'title'
                followed by a single space and the last name (e.g. 'DR who').
                When no title was given it is just the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                and space-separated (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived from the
                stored 'telephone'; the raw E.164 value remains in 'telephone'.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
